_meta.description: Named multi-step pipelines for litrun.py. Each step invokes a python-cli tool from recipes.json with placeholder-substituted args. Placeholders: {input}, {question}, {workdir}. Steps run in order, sharing one {workdir} under ~/.lit-review-tools/workspace/runs/<id>.

workflows.name: PDF(s) → clean Markdown
workflows.description: Convert a PDF file or a folder of PDFs into LLM-ready Markdown with MinerU.

params.input: path to a PDF file or a folder of PDFs

workflows.name: PDF corpus → cited answer
workflows.description: Ask a question over a folder of PDFs with PaperQA2; every claim comes back with a citation.

params.input: folder containing the PDFs to search
params.question: the question to answer over the corpus

workflows.outputs: A citation-backed answer printed to stdout (PaperQA2 caches its index in {input}).

workflows.name: PDFs → Markdown + cited answer
workflows.description: Two-step: convert PDFs to Markdown (MinerU) for a clean artifact, then answer a question over the same corpus with PaperQA2.

params.question: the question to answer over the corpus

workflows.outputs: Markdown under {workdir}/markdown + a citation-backed answer on stdout.

workflows.name: Topic → arXiv PDFs
workflows.description: Search arXiv for a query and download the top-N PDFs (+ manifest) into a folder.

workflows.name: Topic → retrieved corpus → cited answer
workflows.description: End-to-end lightweight review: search arXiv, download the top-N PDFs, then answer a question over them with PaperQA2 (citation-backed). No MCP client needed.

params.query: arXiv search query defining the corpus
params.question: the question to answer over the retrieved papers

workflows.outputs: Retrieved PDFs under {workdir}/pdfs + a citation-backed answer on stdout.

workflows.name: Topic → multi-source corpus → cited answer
workflows.description: Retrieve from BOTH arXiv and OpenAlex into one corpus, then answer a question over it with PaperQA2. Broader coverage than a single source; resilient if one source is rate-limited.

params.question: the question to answer over the retrieved papers

workflows.outputs: A merged arXiv+OpenAlex corpus under {workdir}/corpus + a citation-backed answer on stdout.

workflows.name: Topic → related-work paragraph
workflows.description: Retrieve papers (arXiv + OpenAlex), then have PaperQA2 draft a citation-backed related-work / literature-review paragraph synthesizing themes, methods, and gaps.

params.query: the topic / search query for the related-work section

args: Write a ~250-word related-work / literature-review paragraph on '{query}'. Synthesize the main themes, methods, and open gaps across these papers, and support every claim with an inline citation. Write in an academic tone suitable for a paper's Related Work section.

workflows.outputs: A cited related-work paragraph on stdout, grounded in {workdir}/corpus.

workflows.name: Topic → deduplicated multi-source corpus
workflows.description: Search six scholarly APIs at once (OpenAlex, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, PubMed, Europe PMC, arXiv), deduplicate by DOI, and save one .txt per unique paper. No install, no API key — the keyless starting point for any review.

params.max: how many hits per source before dedup (default 15)

workflows.outputs: results.json (normalised records + per-source counts) and one .txt per unique paper under {workdir}/corpus

workflows.name: Topic → multi-source search → open-access full text
workflows.description: Search six APIs, deduplicate, then resolve every DOI to a legally downloadable full text via Unpaywall → OpenAlex → Europe PMC → arXiv → CORE. Turns an abstract-only corpus into a real full-text one. Keyless.

params.max: how many hits per source before dedup (default 15)

workflows.outputs: PDFs / full-text .txt + oa_report.json (how each DOI resolved, including the closed ones) under {workdir}/corpus

workflows.name: Topic → full-text corpus → cited answer
workflows.description: The strongest end-to-end path: six-source search → dedup → open-access full-text resolution → PaperQA2 answers over the full texts rather than the abstracts. Needs OPENAI_API_KEY for the final step only.

params.question: the question to answer over the retrieved papers
params.max: how many hits per source before dedup (default 12)

workflows.outputs: A full-text corpus under {workdir}/corpus + a citation-backed answer on stdout.
